rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: SOL has the only NEW, SOL-specific institutional catalyst on the tape: Morgan Stanley amended its SEC filings for its upcoming Ether and Solana ETFs at a record-low 0.14% fee — the cheapest in both the U.S. and international markets. A fee war is what happens immediately BEFORE launch, and it is a signal BTC and ETH do not get (their ETF complexes are already mature and are still net -$5.4B YTD in BTC's case). Second, the Senate returns from recess TODAY (Jul 13) with a new CLARITY Act draft expected to drop this week and advocates targeting floor time as soon as the week of Jul 20. A digital-commodity market-structure bill is disproportionately an ALTCOIN catalyst — it is what moves an asset like SOL from regulatory limbo into a defined bucket and unlocks the spot-ETF/staking pipeline; BTC's status was never in doubt, so BTC captures the least of that headline. Third, Alpenglow feature-flag work continues in the Agave/Firedancer releases (finality ~12s -> 100-150ms), keeping the fundamental bid intact underneath.
positions.driver: Relative strength during a FLUSH is the whole trade. Bitcoin broke below $63,000 in an Asian-session leverage flush overnight and the entire tape is red — but SOL, the highest-beta major, went DOWN THE LEAST. Measured on our own dashboard feed 24h-to-24h (Jul 12 11:53Z -> Jul 13 11:53Z): SOL -0.84% ($77.04 -> $76.39), ETH -1.17% ($1,802.54 -> $1,781.40), BTC -1.70% ($63,954.80 -> $62,867.22), XRP -1.71% ($1.0966 -> $1.0779). A high-beta alt that REFUSES to amplify a leverage flush is the cleanest relative-strength tell there is, and it is not a one-day fluke — SOL is up ~20% over the past month while BTC and ETH are not. Sentiment is also inflecting off the floor: Fear & Greed is ~36-44 (Fear/Neutral) today versus 21-26 Extreme Fear a week ago. Runners-up rejected: ETH (yesterday's pick) FAILED its thesis — it could not hold the $1,800 shelf it reclaimed and is back to $1,781, so the setup is invalidated, not repeated; BTC is the weakest major, just flushed sub-$63k, and its ETF flow recovery ($221M single day, ~$510M over three sessions) still only claws back ~9% of $5.4B in 2026 outflows; XRP is the worst 24h performer with no fresh catalyst. Entry = dashboard live feed (asOf 2026-07-13T11:53:05Z).
positions.risks: SOL is the highest-beta major in the book, and the relative-strength edge is thin (0.3-0.9pp) — if BTC's leverage flush extends below $62,000, SOL will amplify the downside, not cushion it, and the 10% stop at $68.75 gets tested fast. The $80 level has rejected SOL repeatedly and is still overhead resistance, so upside into the next 24h is capped by a well-defended pivot. The CLARITY catalyst is a coin-flip: the bill already missed its Jul 4 target and is stalled on three unresolved disputes (crypto ethics disclosures, federal preemption + SEC/CFTC vacancies, and stablecoin yield), with no bipartisan buy-in — a 'delayed again / no floor time' headline when the Senate returns today would hit high-beta alts like SOL harder than BTC. Morgan Stanley's fee filing is an amendment, not an approval or a launch date. Fear & Greed at 36-44 is off the floor but not risk-on. 24/7 headline, dollar and rates risk persists; U.S. inflation data and Q2 earnings land this week.
